title: Russellian panprotopsychism: the quiddities are protophenomenal

statements.text: On Russellian panprotopsychism the quiddities are protophenomenal properties. It does not entail panpsychism: consciousness may occur only where protophenomenal properties are arranged in a consciousness-constituting structure. In this form the view can be seen as a sort of neutral monism.

sources.quote: Russellian panprotopsychism does not entail panpsychism.
In its protophenomenal form, the view can be seen as a sort of neutral monism
